samples.question: The picture shows several separate dark arcs. Every arc is a piece of one and the same circle, and the remaining parts of that circle are not drawn. Four coloured dots are also drawn: one red, one blue, one green and one orange. Exactly one of those dots lies on the completed circle; the other three lie clearly inside or clearly outside it. No dot touches an arc. The background shade, the arc shade, the arc thickness, the number of arcs, the lengths of the arcs and of the gaps between them, the size and position of the circle, the dot size, the total amount of ink, and how close a dot happens to be to the nearest arc all carry no information about the answer. Which coloured dot lies on the completed circle? Answer red, blue, green or orange.
